source: The Ordo for 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026, compiled by Peter Day-Milne, copyright The Latin Mass Society (https://lms.org.uk). Facts only: the days, dates, classes and colours of the dioceses of Wales, taken by hand; the names are in Missalemeum's style. Feasts of single dioceses are left out.

occasions.name: St. Brigid, Virgin
occasions.note: 1 February 2024 and 2025: In all dioceses of Wales, St Brigid V, III Cl, W.

occasions.name: St. David, Bishop & Confessor, Patron of Wales
occasions.note: 1 March 2024 and 2025, and 2 March 2026 (moved off a Sunday of Lent): In both dioceses of Wales, St David B C, I Cl, W, moved from 1 March, the Second Sunday of Lent.

occasions.name: St. George, Martyr
occasions.note: 23 April 2024 and 2026 (in 2025 the Easter Octave took the day): In both dioceses of Wales, St George M, III Cl, R. Universally a commemoration.

occasions.name: Holy Martyrs of England & Wales
occasions.note: 4 May 2024 and 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, The Holy Martyrs of England and Wales, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Augustine of Canterbury, Bishop & Confessor, Apostle of England
occasions.note: 26 May 2025: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Augustine of Canterbury B C, II Cl, W, with a commemoration of St Philip Neri. Universally III Cl on 28 May, which in 2024 most dioceses of England and Wales kept as a feria. In 2024, 26 May was Trinity Sunday and he wasn't kept.

occasions.name: St. Alban, Martyr
occasions.note: 22 June 2024 and 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Alban M, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: Sts. John Fisher, Bishop, & Thomas More, Martyrs
occasions.note: 9 July 2024, 2025 and 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, SS John Fisher B & Thomas More MM, I Cl, R.

occasions.name: Our Lady in Porticu
occasions.note: 17 July 2024, 2025 and 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, Our Lady in Porticu, III Cl, W.

occasions.name: Bl. Edward Powell, Richard Featherstone & Companions, Martyrs
occasions.note: 30 July 2024, 2025 and 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, BB Edward Powell, Richard Featherstone & Comps MM, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Germanus, Bishop & Confessor
occasions.note: 3 August 2024 and 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, St Germanus B C, III Cl, W.

occasions.name: St. Cadoc, Bishop & Martyr
occasions.note: 25 September 2024 and 2025: In all dioceses of Wales, St Cadoc B M, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Edward the Confessor, King
occasions.note: 13 October 2025 and 2026 (in 2024 the Sunday took the day): In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Edward K C, II Cl, W. Universally III Cl.

occasions.name: St. Thomas of Canterbury, Bishop & Martyr
occasions.note: 29 December 2023, 2024 and 2025: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Thomas of Canterbury B M, I Cl, R. Replaces the universal commemoration of St Thomas Becket.
